# 1QR Prime — Full Context

1QR Prime is a web platform for businesses that want one permanent QR to connect customers to a changing digital experience. The official name is 1QR Prime and it is pronounced One QR Prime. Search variants such as 1 QR Prime and 1QRPrime refer to the same independent product at https://1qrprime.com.

## Core product scope

1QR Prime focuses on permanent public QR identities, digital menus, customer pages, table-specific QR context, restaurant ordering workflows, payment destination handoff, staff permissions and analytics generated by recorded product activity. It does not claim to be Google, a bank, or a complete replacement for every POS, inventory or accounting product.

## Payment boundary

A UPI or payment-app deep link is a handoff, not proof of payment. A merchant should confirm receipt through the relevant bank or payment provider. Sensitive payment destination changes belong behind authenticated merchant controls.
